These datasets provide the transfer coefficients (TCs) for material recovery from waste streams that fall under slags and ashes. The recovery model of steel slags is different from other waste streams in this category. Consequently, the TCs for steel slags is in a different format and hence, is uploaded separately. The recovery model for all other waste streams can be found here: Source code for SLASH recovery model | FutuRaM.
